audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: 3-year average net profit margin FY2015-FY2017 calculated as (3.056 + 2.270 + 3.118) / 3
audit_report.rationale: The analyst calculated (3.056 + 2.270 + 3.118) / 3 = 2.814..., which rounds to 2.8%, but there is an error in the underlying margin calculations. The analyst used 2018 revenue (C01: 39,403) for the 2017 margin instead of 2017 revenue, pairing C04 (2017 net earnings) with 2018 revenue data. This creates a systematic error in the 2017 margin calculation (3.118% should be 1228/39403=3.118%, but this pairs wrong fiscal years). The average is thus computed from partially incorrect individual margins.
